statutes.title: Simplified Method for Computing Individual Income Tax
text_en: Imposes individual income tax at 0% up to $44,725; 1.95% to $225,975; and top rate 2.50% (HB 1158) in North Dakota.
text_es: Impone impuesto sobre la renta individual de 0% hasta $44,725; 1.95% a $225,975; y tasa máxima de 2.50% (HB 1158) en Dakota del Norte.
